matching_evaluation.method: Nested image cross-validation of trained ConvNeXt classifiers; view mode and regularization chosen inside each training fold
matching_evaluation.scope: Exploratory held-out photos of the same ten known lots. Architecture exploration reused this collection; capture sessions and near duplicates remain unconfirmed. This is not new-lot origin or lab-value accuracy.
matching_evaluation.selection_rule: Three inner stratified folds select orientation view mode and regularization by balanced accuracy. Feature scaling fits only training photos; outer queries are excluded from all fitting and selection.

training_protocol.name: ConvNeXt + linear classifier · 224px + 336px features · C=1
training_protocol.augmentation_scope: Deterministic photo views averaged within each source; identical training and serving transforms. Each source counts once.
training_protocol.preprocessing: EXIF orientation, bilinear shorter-side resize 236/crop224 or resize354/crop336, ImageNet normalization

final_refit.purpose: All-lot pilot fitting after model selection; training fit is not reported as test accuracy.
